what: The hook parse probe node (node_hook_parse_probe_compute) that renders the script a lab host runs to judge the hook scripts its Claude loads. The placement script calls it in the dispatch venv and the suites render the script from this commit; a node that cannot run prints HOOKPARSE unknown, so the host is refused. Raise dispatch_venv_floor.json to this commit or later in the same change, as the venv must hold the node.
